Prestige Estates launches major Bengaluru housing projects

Prestige Estates has launched two new residential projects in Bengaluru. One project, located in Devanahalli, is valued at Rs 1,750 crore. The company anticipates a total revenue of Rs 2,850 crore from these two new housing developments.
